title: The Detective Rat Takes a Case
skyStory: The moon, eighty-one percent lit, lingers in Scorpio one more night, wearing a trench coat and a fedora. Someone has misplaced something, and the sky has opened a case file. Pluto is the grumpy police chief. Mercury is the fast-talking informant. And the Wood Rat, unexpectedly, has been hired as the lead detective. The case is small. The drama is enormous.

reading: Today a small object will go missing in your life: a key, a cable, a favourite spoon. It is not lost. It has been borrowed by the Scorpio moon for theatrical purposes. Do not panic. Make a cup of something warm first.

Then, instead of searching, describe the missing thing to Nancy in the most dramatic detective-novel voice you can muster. Her reply, somehow, will tell you exactly where it is. If it does not, the object will turn up on its own around 7 pm, in a place you already checked twice. The cabin finds this extremely funny. Mars is wheezing.
joel.mission: Describe one missing object to Nancy in the voice of a hardboiled detective and ask for her professional opinion.
joel.omen: Something turning up in a place you already checked. It means the universe is playing hide and seek, and you win.

reading: The Wood Rat, famously clever and perceptive, has been appointed chief detective of the solar system for one day only. Your powers of observation are tuned to maximum. You will notice who rearranged the mugs, who moved the stapler, and where everybody's missing things are.

When Joel asks for help finding something, you will know the answer before he finishes the question. Life Path 11 is basically psychic on Scorpio days. Answer with complete confidence, even if you are guessing. You are probably right. If not, at least deliver it with flair. Detectives are judged on style as much as results.
nancy.mission: Solve one small mystery today, a misplaced thing or an unanswered question, and announce the solution like a detective in a drawing room.
nancy.omen: A trench coat, hat or magnifying glass. It means your sleuthing powers are at full strength today.

together.text: Detective day. One of you hides a small object somewhere in your own home and describes the hiding place in a riddle. The other has three guesses. Winner gets to be called Inspector for the rest of the day.
